description: This Scala source file defines the ExecutorPodsSnapshotsStoreImpl class, which manages the state and propagation of executor pod snapshots in a Kubernetes environment within Apache Spark. It handles subscriber registration, snapshot updates, and notification mechanisms for executor pod states.

classes.name: ExecutorPodsSnapshotsStoreImpl
classes.description: Manages executor pod snapshots, handles subscriber registration, updates, and notifications in Spark on Kubernetes.

classes.name: SnapshotsSubscriber
classes.description: Inner class that manages individual subscriber buffers and processes snapshot notifications.

methods.name: addSubscriber
methods.description: Registers a new subscriber with a specified processing interval and callback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all polling tasks and shuts down the executor service gracefully.

methods.name: updatePod
methods.description: Updates the snapshot with a new executor pod state.

methods.name: replaceSnapshot
methods.description: Replaces the entire snapshot with a new set of pods.

methods.name: addCurrentSnapshotToSubscribers
methods.description: Adds the current snapshot to all subscribers' buffers.

methods.name: addCurrentSnapshot
methods.description: Adds the current snapshot to a subscriber's buffer.

methods.name: processSnapshots
methods.description: Processes snapshot notifications for a subscriber.

methods.name: processSnapshotsInternal
methods.description: Internal method that handles the actual notification logic, including locking and scheduling.
